Footer.tagline: A free, open geography education platform.
Footer.note: Content is under active development; new provinces and topics are added regularly. Published data is based on official sources (TÜİK, HGM, Ministry of Interior, MGM).

Home.metaTitle: Coğrafya Platformu — Geography of Türkiye and the World
Home.metaDescription: Free, sourced geography content for the 81 provinces of Türkiye, the countries of the world and landforms. Maps, topic guides and more.
Home.heading: Explore Türkiye and the world through geography
Home.lede: Free geography pages — province, country and landform details, with curriculum-aligned topic guides.

Map.sectionHeading: Choose a province from the map
Map.sectionBody: Hover a province on the map of Türkiye (or focus it with the keyboard) and follow the card to its detail page. Published provinces are interactive; the rest are added as their content clears verification.
Map.mapTitle: Map of the provinces of Türkiye

About.metaDescription: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that presents the geography of Türkiye and the world through free, sourced and accessible content.
About.heading: About
About.body1: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that aims to make geography free and accessible to everyone. Content is grounded in authoritative sources and passes an independent verification step before publication.
About.body2: The platform is under development. This page is a demonstration of the multilingual architecture and SEO foundations; content will deepen as coverage expands.

Turkiye.metaDescription: Explore the 81 provinces of Türkiye on an interactive map. Location, population, area, climate and landforms — sourced, structured detail pages for each province.
Turkiye.heading: Map of Türkiye
Turkiye.intro: Explore the 81 provinces of Türkiye on an interactive map. Select a province to reach its sourced detail page covering location, population, climate and landforms.

ProvinceDetail.metaDescription: Sourced information on the location, climate, population and area of {name}, a province in the {region} region of Türkiye.
ProvinceDetail.heading: Geography of {name}
ProvinceDetail.introFallbackPopulationYear: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye, with a population of {population, number} as of {year}.
ProvinceDetail.introFallbackPopulation: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye, with a population of {population, number}.
ProvinceDetail.introFallbackArea: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye, covering an area of {area, number} km².
ProvinceDetail.introFallbackRegion: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye.
ProvinceDetail.hydrographyNone: This province has no significant rivers, lakes or dams.
ProvinceDetail.sources: Data is grounded in official sources: population from TÜİK (ADNKS), area from the General Directorate of Mapping (HGM), district count from the Ministry of Interior; climate and provincial-centre elevation/coordinates from MGM.
